params.label: Name
params.help: Shown in the app and used as the network name (name.local)

params.label: Page lock
params.help: Off: joining the board's Wi-Fi is the only gate. On: changes, restart and the like need the page password (turning it off too)

params.label: Page password
params.help: Used only while Page lock is on. Kept as a salted hash; never shown

params.label: Wi-Fi network
params.help: Empty: the board makes its own setup Wi-Fi. A new network saved with Wi-Fi password empty is joined as an open network

params.label: Wi-Fi password
params.help: Never shown. Empty keeps the stored one, except with a new network: then the network is open (no password)

params.label: Setup hotspot password
params.help: The password of the board's own setup Wi-Fi (Proptroller-XXXX), used when no network is set or it cannot be joined. The default is simply "password": change it here, 8-63 characters

params.label: OUT1 max on
params.help: 0 = no limit

params.label: OUT2 max on
params.help: 0 = no limit

params.label: OUT3 max on
params.help: 0 = no limit

params.label: OUT4 max on
params.help: 0 = no limit

params.label: RLY1 max on
params.help: 0 = no limit

params.label: RLY2 max on
params.help: 0 = no limit

params.label: CC1 max on
params.help: 0 = no limit

params.label: CC2 max on
params.help: 0 = no limit

params.label: RLY1 / RLY2 never together
params.help: For reversing a motor with the two relays

params.label: TRIG1 input type
params.help: switch: switch, button or relay contact (closes to ground). sensor_high: powered sensor (its signal goes high), fed from the jack's ring (3.3 V, 15 mA at most); it must drive its signal low when idle, or it reads as always on. In sensor_high an unplugged cable counts as a trigger: use switch for anything safety-related

params.label: TRIG2 input type
params.help: switch: switch, button or relay contact (closes to ground). sensor_high: powered sensor (its signal goes high), fed from the jack's ring (3.3 V, 15 mA at most); it must drive its signal low when idle, or it reads as always on. In sensor_high an unplugged cable counts as a trigger: use switch for anything safety-related

params.label: TRIG1 starts a script effect
params.help: How a show script's first "wait for" on this input starts its effect. ready: released since the effect's last run, then held for the debounce while the effect could start (a press held through a run starts the next one as soon as it can; taps while it cannot start are not saved). return: a press after a release of about 0.2 s; one while the effect cannot start (its own run too) is saved and starts it when it can if still held then

params.label: TRIG2 starts a script effect
params.help: How a show script's first "wait for" on this input starts its effect. ready: released since the effect's last run, then held for the debounce while the effect could start (a press held through a run starts the next one as soon as it can; taps while it cannot start are not saved). return: a press after a release of about 0.2 s; one while the effect cannot start (its own run too) is saved and starts it when it can if still held then

params.label: Script effects started remotely without the remote trigger
params.help: Names of show-script effects, separated by commas, that the web page, MQTT and serial may start without remote_trigger_enable (one start waits while they are busy). Every other effect needs it

params.label: Trigger debounce
params.help: For the pulse-and-recover effect: the hold-to-confirm time (TRIG1 closed this long while ready starts a run)

params.label: Pixel brightness
params.help: A cap on every colour (100 = full); the firmware does not measure pixel current

params.label: DMX port
params.help: s4 sends DMX to a MAX485 module on expansion S4 (SHOW-SCRIPT.md §7.4)

params.label: Ambient sound while idle
params.help: Loops the ambient sound; skipped when the card has no such file

params.label: Ambient sound
params.help: Sound 1 is the card's mp3/0001-<name>.mp3, sound 2 mp3/0002-<name>.mp3, …

params.label: Trigger sound
params.help: Sound 1 is the card's mp3/0001-<name>.mp3, sound 2 mp3/0002-<name>.mp3, …

params.label: Ask the player for ACKs
params.help: Turn off for clones that never answer

params.label: STOP button on the page
params.help: Off hides the phone page's STOP (for a prop whose emergency stop is pulling the power)

params.label: Start buttons on the page
params.help: How the phone page's buttons start a script effect: a click, or a press held about a second (letting go early sends nothing)

params.label: MQTT broker
params.help: Host name or address; empty = MQTT off. Topics: proptroller/<name>/…

params.label: RLY1 role
params.help: shows = driven by shows; trigger_repeat = a pulse for each accepted trigger (chain the next controller); sound_trigger = a pulse when a sound starts. An output with another role cannot be used in shows

params.label: RLY2 role
params.help: shows = driven by shows; trigger_repeat = a pulse for each accepted trigger (chain the next controller); sound_trigger = a pulse when a sound starts. An output with another role cannot be used in shows

params.label: CC1 role
params.help: shows = driven by shows; trigger_repeat = a pulse for each accepted trigger (chain the next controller); sound_trigger = a pulse when a sound starts. An output with another role cannot be used in shows

params.label: CC2 role
params.help: shows = driven by shows; trigger_repeat = a pulse for each accepted trigger (chain the next controller); sound_trigger = a pulse when a sound starts. An output with another role cannot be used in shows

params.label: Built-in effect
params.help: pulse_and_recover: TRIG1 starts a run (OUT1 pulse, then the OUT2 recovery), TRIG2 recovers only. Those terminals are then the effect's

params.label: OUT3 after-pulse
params.help: OUT3 on after the pulse; the effect is ready again when OUT3 goes off while OUT2 recovers in the background

params.label: OUT4 ready lamp
params.help: OUT4 steady when ready, blinking otherwise

params.label: Cooldown
params.help: Counted from the first run; 0 = no cooldown

params.label: Safety off at power-on
params.help: Off: hold TRIG1 2 s after power-on to release the safety

params.label: Recover
params.help: cycle = the recovery without the pulse; timed = OUT2 for the recover time; hold = OUT2 while TRIG2 is held (30 s at most)

params.label: Trigger out / sound out pulse
params.help: Every run pulses the outputs whose role is trigger repeat or sound trigger this long

params.label: Remote trigger
params.help: Lets the web, MQTT and serial start runs. Off at every power-on; from a phone page it stays on only while that page is open
